title: REFUTED SLOT — no Conference Board Consumer Confidence release on this date; the December 2026 print is tracked at consumer-confidence-2026-12-22 (12-21→12-23). 2026-12-29 is FHFA HPI only, 9:00 a.m. ET
source: EST: this date is the publisher's stated rule applied forward, and the rule does not govern December. conference-board.org/topics/consumer-confidence (fetched direct 2026-09-06, HTTP 200) states "The Conference Board publishes the Consumer Confidence Index (R) at 10 a.m. ET on the last Tuesday of every month" and names only "Tuesday, September 29th at 10 AM ET" — December 2026 is named nowhere. The Board's own PRNewswire advisory, dateline "NEW YORK, Dec. 21, 2020" (fetched direct 2026-09-06, HTTP 200), reads verbatim: "As a reminder, The Conference Board's December Consumer Confidence Index (R) release date has moved from December 29th at 10 AM ET to tomorrow, December 22nd, at 10 AM ET." 2020-12-29 was that month's last Tuesday — the Board scheduled this exact slot and vacated it. Ten sourced December editions put the release on/after Christmas 2016-2019 (2016-12-27 Tue = last Tuesday; 2017-12-27 Wed; 2018-12-27 Thu; 2019-12-31 Tue = last Tuesday) and before Christmas in all six since (2020-12-22, 2021-12-22, 2022-12-21, 2023-12-20, 2024-12-23, 2025-12-23). Kept as estimate rather than deleted because the id cannot be removed from the board while another lane's proposal for it stands (#1717), and an honest title shadowing that proposal is strictly better than the proposal's own. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: Canonical entry written by this id's own never-assessed research (2026-09-06) after reading the single prior proposal (proposals/consumer-confidence-2026-12-29.from-fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29.json, filed by the FHFA lane the same day), which is now inert and safe to prune. THE FINDING IS THAT THE PROPOSED EVENT IS NOT REAL: December 29 is the calendar slot the Conference Board scheduled for its December 2020 release, publicly moved off, and has not returned to in the six editions since. The proposal derived it by applying the Board's stated last-Tuesday rule forward, which is the same derivation any future automated sweep will make — this entry exists to stop that re-derivation, not to assert a print. DO NOT TRADE OR MODEL A CONSUMER-CONFIDENCE RELEASE ON THIS DATE; the real December 2026 print is consumer-confidence-2026-12-22 (window 12-21 to 12-23, itself an estimate). Impact downgraded medium -> low against the proposal, on the finding that no print occurs here; it returns to medium the moment the Board names 12-29. CORRECTION BANKED FOR A SIBLING LANE, not applied by this one (#1449 — a lane never edits another event's file): fhfa-hpi-2026-12-29 declines its own tape claim on the grounds that "68 of 68 measured release days since 2021 are also CB days", but its five December observations are not — FHFA took 12-28/12-27/12-26/12-31/12-30 while the Conference Board took 12-22/12-21/12-20/12-23/12-23, zero overlap. The corrected count is 63 of 68, and FHFA's own 2026-12-29 session is the modern set's FIRST DE-CONFOUNDED December observation, cleaner than that ledger tells its next reader. Full record, sources and the two forward tests: docs/research/events/consumer-confidence-2026-12-29.md. Not a trade: symbols is empty and a re-grep of trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md for any macro- or sentiment-keyed playbook returns 0 hits.
